info.description: REST API for warehouse operations, order fulfillment and ML insights.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
Return an access token and set the refresh-token cookie.

Too many wrong passwords lock the account (and the client) for a while: 429 with a
Retry-After header, even for the right password, until the lockout ends.

post.summary: Get a new access token using the refresh-token cookie
post.description: Rotate the refresh token and return a new access token.

post.summary: Log out (revoke the refresh token of this browser)
post.description: Revoke the current refresh token and clear the cookie. Always succeeds.

AdjustmentRequest.title: AdjustmentRequest
AdjustmentRequest.description: A correction: units found / lost, damaged, restored or written off.

AuditLogFilters.title: AuditLogFilters
AuditLogFilters.description: The record types and actions that occur in the audit log (for the filters).

BinDetailResponse.title: BinDetailResponse
BinDetailResponse.description: A bin with its full path, e.g. for the result of a scan.

CustomerCreate.title: CustomerCreate
CustomerCreate.description: A new customer. The code is generated (CUST-0001, ...) when left empty.

CycleCountRecord.title: CycleCountRecord
CycleCountRecord.description: Counted quantities; may be sent several times while the count is open.

CycleCountSummary.title: CycleCountSummary
CycleCountSummary.description: A count in a list (without its lines).

DelayAccuracy.title: DelayAccuracy
DelayAccuracy.description: A past delivery-risk run against when the parcels then arrived.

DemandAccuracy.title: DemandAccuracy
DemandAccuracy.description: A past demand forecast run against what customers then ordered.

DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus
DocumentStatus.description: Life cycle of transfers and adjustments.

DurationKpi.title: DurationKpi
DurationKpi.description: Average and median of a duration, over the orders it could be measured for.

GenerateLayoutRequest.title: GenerateLayoutRequest
GenerateLayoutRequest.description:
Create `racks` racks x `shelves_per_rack` shelves x `bins_per_shelf` bins in a zone.

New racks are numbered after the highest existing rack number in the zone. Rack i gets
distance `first_rack_distance_m + i * distance_step_m` to the packing station.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Response body of the health endpoint.

InventoryResponse.title: InventoryResponse
InventoryResponse.description: Stock of one product in one bin.

MLSummary.title: MLSummary
MLSummary.description: Headline numbers of the latest predictions (dashboard).

ModelSummary.title: ModelSummary
ModelSummary.description: The selected model of a use case and how it did on the test period.

MovementSummary.title: MovementSummary
MovementSummary.description: How many products are fast, medium and slow, and their share of picks.

OrderCreate.title: OrderCreate
OrderCreate.description: A new order. The shipping address defaults to the customer's address.

PackConfirmation.title: PackConfirmation
PackConfirmation.description: What the packer counted into the parcels, and the parcels themselves.

Period.title: Period
Period.description: The date range the period KPIs cover (both days included, UTC).

PickConfirmation.title: PickConfirmation
PickConfirmation.description: What the picker scanned and how many units they took.

PredictionCheck.title: PredictionCheck
PredictionCheck.description:
How the latest checkable predictions did: runs made before the last day with
orders, whose days have (partly) passed. None: nothing to check yet.

ProductPublicResponse.title: ProductPublicResponse
ProductPublicResponse.description: What every logged-in user (including customers) may see: no costs or margins.

ProductResponse.title: ProductResponse
ProductResponse.description: Full product data for warehouse users (admin, manager, staff).

ProductStockResponse.title: ProductStockResponse
ProductStockResponse.description: Where a product is stored and how much of it, over all bins.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description: Partial update. min/max stock are checked again against the stored values.

RateKpi.title: RateKpi
RateKpi.description: `good` of `total`, as a percentage (None when there is nothing to measure).

ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest
ReasonRequest.description: Holding or cancelling an order always needs a reason.

ReceiveRequest.title: ReceiveRequest
ReceiveRequest.description: Goods arrived and were put away into a bin.

Reference.title: Reference
Reference.description: Short summary of a related record.

ReferenceType.title: ReferenceType
ReferenceType.description: The document a movement belongs to (`reference_id` is that document's id).

ReserveRequest.title: ReserveRequest
ReserveRequest.description:
Hold available units of a product, e.g. for an order.

With `bin_id`, units are held in that bin. Without it, the system picks the bins:
picking zones first, then the racks closest to packing (shortest walk for pickers).

RoleName.title: RoleName
RoleName.description: The four platform roles (see project document, section 2.3).

ShipmentEventCreate.title: ShipmentEventCreate
ShipmentEventCreate.description: A tracking update from the carrier (or entered by staff).

SpaceUse.title: SpaceUse
SpaceUse.description: Bins and capacity of active bins, and how much of it is used now.

StatusNote.title: StatusNote
StatusNote.description: Optional note for a status change (e.g. confirming an order).

StockStatusCounts.title: StockStatusCounts
StockStatusCounts.description: Active products by availability (each product counted once).

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
Access token returned after login or refresh.

The refresh token is NOT part of the body: it is set as an httpOnly cookie.

TransferRequest.title: TransferRequest
TransferRequest.description: Move available units of a product from one bin to another.

TransferSubmitResponse.title: TransferSubmitResponse
TransferSubmitResponse.description: `applied` = done now; otherwise the transfer waits for a manager (status pending).

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description: Data an administrator provides to create a user.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description: A user as returned by the API. Never contains the password hash.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Partial update; only the fields that are sent are changed.

ZoneType.title: ZoneType
ZoneType.description: What a zone is used for (drives slotting and put-away rules later).

app__schemas__inventory__DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest
app__schemas__inventory__DecisionRequest.description: A manager's note when approving (optional) or rejecting (required) a request.
